description_en: Obtain an authorization token for H5 native number verification. The response includes an AccessToken and a JwtToken
description_zh: 获取授权Token用于H5本机号码校验的鉴权，返回结果包括AccessToken和JwtToken
kebab_example: aliyun dypnsapi get-auth-token --url https://www.aliyundoc.com/ --origin https://www.aliyundoc.com --scene-code FC100000106430000 --biz-type 1 --cm-api-code 1 --cu-api-code 1 --ct-api-code 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAuthToken

parameters.help_en:
URL of the request page. Enter the URL you specified when creating the authentication plan in the console. Format: protocol + // + domain name + /.

For testing, you can temporarily use a public IP address. Use a domain name for production
parameters.help_zh:
请求页面地址。请传入在控制台创建认证方案时填入的页面地址，格式为“协议 + // + 域名 + /”。

测试可暂时传入公网IP地址，正式上线请使用域名
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en: Origin URL. Enter the origin URL you specified when creating the authentication plan in the console. Format: protocol + // + domain name
parameters.help_zh: 请求源地址。请传入在控制台创建认证方案时填入的源地址，格式为“协议 + // + 域名”
parameters.name: origin

parameters.help_en:
Authentication plan code.

This parameter is required due to plan upgrades. After creating an authentication plan in the console, pass its code. For details, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/615129.html
parameters.help_zh:
方案Code。

因方案升级，本参数为必填，请在控制台创建认证方案后传入方案Code，具体操作请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/615129.html
parameters.name: scene_code

parameters.help_en:
Business type. Valid values:

0: Native number verification.

1: One-click logon.

This parameter is required due to flow optimizations that reduce client-side authentication calls
parameters.help_zh:
业务类型。取值：
0：本机号码认证。
1：一键登录。
因业务流程优化，减少了客户端鉴权接口的调用，本参数为必填
